text.tspan: 0) ACQUIRE — Visor starts the story, the pipeline is built and wired to the retention store
3) SEAL (ship-on-seal) — a decayed chunk is OWNED by the retention store AND queued for shipping at once
chunk is RETAINED — never freed until it is durable (E ≤ W)
4) SHIP — extraction ULT drains, the RDMA fan-out carries the keeper's reporter id, and the outcome is routed back through the disposal seam
5) CONFIRM PERSISTED — the grapher reports its persisted watermark W, and only now may covered chunks free
6) STALL RE-SEND — un-acked or un-covered chunks are re-shipped after the resend timeout (idempotent, grapher dedups)
the retention store also serves reads from keeper memory — playback tail reads (tail_get_sequences / tail_get_events) and the player's story_range_fetch — see watermark_feedback_sequence

svg.text: index the last-N tail (EventSequence -> chunk), mark state.in_queue = true
markSendFailed(chunk) (stays retained and readable, re-sent later)
free every chunk where shipped AND endTime ≤ W AND tail-released (frees oldest-first, keeps E ≤ W)
